In [[3645 BBY]], a '''duel''' occurred on the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Odacer-Faustin]], between [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Rojo Trace]], and [[Shak'Weth]], [[Sith Blademaster|Blademaster]] of the planet's [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]].
